summary: Tests-only red-phase run for issue #39. Test deliverables committed at HEAD 8933444: (a) solver parity corpus fixture (verbatim from viamin/color_matching#112, merged upstream as priv/parity/v1/corpus.json) + SolverParityCorpusTests replaying every scenario through WeightedSquaredErrorScorer (exact score-table equality), earliest-wins selection (selected index/hex/error/tie_broke/tied_indices), and CompositionSolver's fast path on 1x1 grids; (b) OpenAPI snapshot fixture for the two consumed /api/v1 operations (derived from viamin/color_matching#113, merged: spec served at GET /api/v1/openapi.json) + OpenAPIContractTests pinning paths, required printer_profile_id query param, bearer auth, envelope required-keys, and spec-minimal payload decoding; (c) PaletteAPIClientTests extended with the wire behavior (URLs, headers, 401/5xx/malformed error mapping, tolerant envelope decoding) that the swift-openapi-generator migration must preserve; (d) docs/parity-corpus.md documenting corpus/snapshot location and refresh. Execution blocker: this container has NO Swift toolchain ('swift: command not found'); bin/lint exits 0 by design with 'Swift toolchain not available; skipping build and tests'. Pre-verification instead done by replaying the corpus in Python with the identical canonical-order IEEE754 arithmetic (script: /tmp/opencode/replay_corpus.py): all 12 scenarios, including 5 tie scenarios, agree EXACTLY (scores, selections, exclusions) with the corpus, so the Swift parity tests are expected green on a macOS host ('cd ColorComposerCore && swift test'). Parity findings for the PR description: corpus algorithm_version=1, selection=earliest-index-wins, missing_policy=excluded-when-any-positive-weight-channel-missing; ties broken by earliest index (4 tie scenarios incl. three-way tie); unknown weight keys (ultraviolet) ignored; zero-weight missing channels neither exclude nor contribute. /api/v1 shape findings: spec marks printer_profile REQUIRED inside ColorsResponse and name/palette_id/sort_order REQUIRED per color, while the Swift DTOs model them optional (deliberate tolerance pinned by testClientToleratesOptionalPrinterProfileDespiteSpecRequiringIt and ProfileColorCache's optional profile); rgb and palette_name are optional per spec (hex fallback pinned). Implementation deliverables (swift-openapi-generator/runtime dependency, generated client, PaletteAPIClient migration, README edit, PR description) are intentionally deferred to the implementation run per phase rules.
